svg.text: EACH SLIDE IS A 12 MM WINDOW. SHOWN MAGNIFIED, SO THE PATTERN IS VISIBLE
To make them: print blueprints/slides-print.svg at 100% on laser transparency film.
Black film, clear holes 200 µm apart. Spots land about 1 mm apart on the screen.
Or order it as photoplotted film at 20% scale: holes 40 µm apart, spots 4.9 mm apart.
